about: Christmas Walk in the Woods is a lighted trail run by The Savage Woods west of Loveland.
It runs December 12 to 31, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
The woods are closed on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
Children 5 and under are free on lights only evenings.
Photo backdrops include Santa's House and an elf workshop.
A 1968 Chevrolet Christmas truck is another backdrop.
Santa appears on special nights with live music.
The Original Dickens Carolers play December 12, 21, 22 and 23.
Tubas at Christmas play December 19 and 20.
Special nights cost $14 for ages 11 and up and $7 for ages 10 and under.
Pets are not allowed at any Savage Woods event.
